newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields rise to 56.93 percent.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields rise to 56.93 percent.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged up to 56.93 percent from 56.05 percent at the last sale on October 3, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 16.330 million UAH 7.187 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.300 million UAH 6.306 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 163,302 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 8.
